# Set up environment and load data 
```{r}
# Clean environment
rm( list = ls() )

# Load libraries
library(tidyverse)
library(phytools)
library(ape)
library(treeio)
library(ggtree)
library(ggplot2)
library(ggnewscale)
library(RColorBrewer)
library(cartography)
library(khroma)

# Import tree
Fasttree <- read.tree("~/GitHub/GBS-GWAS-CDC-EOD-LOD/1.Bioinformatics/Ouputs/Phylogenies/CDC_NLD/FastTree_phylo.tre")
Fasttree_mid <- midpoint.root(Fasttree)


# Load metadata
serotypes <- read.delim("~/GitHub/GBS-GWAS-CDC-EOD-LOD/1.Bioinformatics/Ouputs/Strain Typing/CDC_NDL/Serotypes.txt", header=T) |> mutate(GBS.SBG = ifelse(GBS.SBG=="", NA, GBS.SBG)) 
CCs <- read.csv("~/GitHub/GBS-GWAS-CDC-EOD-LOD/1.Bioinformatics/Ouputs/Strain Typing/CDC_NDL/combined_results_with_cc.txt") |> dplyr::select(Sample, clonal_complex)
SCs <- read.csv("~/GitHub/GBS-GWAS-CDC-EOD-LOD/1.Bioinformatics/Ouputs/Strain Typing/CDC_NDL/GBS_GWAS_db_core_clusters.csv") |> rename(Sample=Taxon, SC=Cluster)
STs <- read.delim("~/GitHub/GBS-GWAS-CDC-EOD-LOD/1.Bioinformatics/Ouputs/Strain Typing/CDC_NDL/ST_results.txt") |>
  mutate(ST2 = str_remove(str_remove(ST,"\\*"),"\\?"))


# Load phenotypes
phenotypes <- read.table("~/GitHub/GBS-GWAS-CDC-EOD-LOD/0.Raw_data/phenotypes_CDC_NDL.txt", header=T)
phenotypes <- phenotypes |>
  rename(Sample =samples ) |> 
  mutate(Age_cat = ifelse(binary==0, "EOD", "LOD/VLOD"))

# Prep metadata for tree
typing_data <- left_join(left_join(left_join(left_join(serotypes, CCs ), SCs), phenotypes), (STs |> dplyr::select(Sample, ST, ST2)))
fewer5_SC <- which(table(typing_data$SC)<=10)
metadata_tree <- typing_data |>
  mutate(SC2= ifelse(SC %in% fewer5_SC, "other", SC))|>
  mutate(SC2= factor(SC2, level=c(1:14, "other")))|>
  mutate(Serotype2 = str_remove(str_remove(GBS.SBG,"\\*"),"\\?"))|>
  mutate(Serotype2 = ifelse(grepl("III-", Serotype2), "III", Serotype2))|>
  mutate(Serotype2 = factor(Serotype2, levels=c("Ia", "Ib","II", "III", "IV", "V","VI","VII","VIII", "IX")))|> 
  rename("label" = "Sample")|> 
  filter(label %in% Fasttree_mid$tip.label)|>
  mutate(Age_cat = ifelse(grepl("ERR", label), ifelse(binary ==1, "EOD", "LOD/VLOD"), Age_cat))
    

# Fix missing CCs
ref_ST_cc_df <- rbind(unique(metadata_tree|> filter(!grepl("\\*", ST), !grepl("\\?", ST)) |> dplyr::select(ST, clonal_complex)), 
                       data.frame(ST= c(1750, 2107, 137, 1809, 235, 482, 1946, 2106, 234),
                                  clonal_complex=c("cc17", "cc17", "cc17", "cc23", "cc1", "cc17", "cc17", "cc19", "cc23")))

# Load CDC and NL accessions
library(xlsx)
NL_metadata <- read.xlsx("~/GitHub/GBS-GWAS-CDC-EOD-LOD/0.Raw_data/Netherlands_Sanger_metadata.xlsx", 1) 
NL_accessions <- NL_metadata |> pull(ENA.lane.accession)
CDC_metadata <- read.table("~/GitHub/GBS-GWAS-CDC-EOD-LOD/0.Raw_data/CDC_SRR_Acc_List.txt", header=F) 
CDC_accessions <- CDC_metadata |> pull(V1)


# Join tree with metadata
metadata_tree_v0 <- unique(left_join(metadata_tree |> dplyr::select(-clonal_complex), ref_ST_cc_df |> rename(ST2=ST)) |> 
  mutate(clonal_complex = case_when(
    label == "SRR29440471" ~ "cc19",
    label == "SRR29458952" ~ "cc17",
    label == "SRR29459527" ~ "cc1",
    label == "SRR29476238" ~ "cc459",
    label == "SRR29480489" ~ "cc17",
    label == "SRR29489178" ~ "cc17",
    label == "SRR29489593" ~ "cc1",
    label == "SRR29489703" ~ "cc19",
    label == "SRR29506764" ~ "cc19",
    label == "SRR29506975" ~ "cc19",
    label == "SRR29508494" ~ "cc1",
    label == "SRR31502751" ~ "cc452",
    label == "SRR5063593" ~ "cc19",
    label == "ERR1659749" ~ "cc19",
    label == "SRR23753882" ~ "cc17",
    label == "SRR23754097" ~ "cc17",
    TRUE ~ clonal_complex # keep existing value for all others
  )) |> 
  mutate(clonal_complex = ifelse(ST2 %in% c(4,16,103, 130, 255, 929, 932, 1553, 1559,1580, 1606), "No_CC", clonal_complex))) |> 
  mutate(Country= ifelse(label %in% NL_accessions, "Netherlands", ifelse(label %in% CDC_accessions, "USA", "Taiwan")))


# Join metadata and tree 
Fasttree_mid_metadata <- full_join(keep.tip(Fasttree_mid, metadata_tree_v0$label), metadata_tree_v0 , by = 'label')

# Prepare heatmap data for phylo
## Serotype
Metadata_Serotype = metadata_tree_v0 |> dplyr::select(Serotype2)
row.names(Metadata_Serotype) <-  metadata_tree_v0$label
colnames(Metadata_Serotype)= c("1")
## CC
Metadata_CC= metadata_tree_v0 |> dplyr::select(clonal_complex)
row.names(Metadata_CC) <-  metadata_tree_v0$label
colnames(Metadata_CC)= c("2")
## Age category
Metadata_Age_cat= metadata_tree_v0|> dplyr::select(Age_cat)
row.names(Metadata_Age_cat) <-  metadata_tree_v0$label
colnames(Metadata_Age_cat)= c("3")
## Country
Metadata_Country = metadata_tree_v0 |> dplyr::select(Country)
row.names(Metadata_Country) <-  metadata_tree_v0$label
colnames(Metadata_Country)= c("4")

# Subset metadata by country
metadata_tree_CDC <- metadata_tree_v0 |> filter(Country =="USA")
metadata_tree_NL <- metadata_tree_v0 |> filter(Country =="Netherlands")

# Subset tree by country
Fasttree_mid_CDC <- keep.tip(Fasttree_mid, metadata_tree_CDC$label)
Fasttree_mid_NL<- keep.tip(Fasttree_mid, metadata_tree_NL$label)

# Add tree metadata
Fasttree_mid_metadata_CDC <- full_join(Fasttree_mid_CDC, metadata_tree_CDC , by = 'label')
Fasttree_mid_metadata_NL<- full_join(Fasttree_mid_NL, metadata_tree_NL , by = 'label')

# Prepare colors for phylo
SC_colors <- c("#dbdb8d", "#1f77b4", "#ff7f0e", "#2ca02c", "#d62728", "#9467bd","#8c564b", "#e377c2", "#7f7f7f", "#bcbd22", "#17becf", "#f7b6d2",  "#c5b0d5", "#c49c94", "black")
names(SC_colors) <- c(1:14, "other")
Serotype_colors <- c(color("muted")(9),"#D55E00" , "grey")
names(Serotype_colors) <- levels(Metadata_Serotype[,1])
# CC_colors <- carto.pal(pal1 = "pastel.pal" ,n1 = 13)
CC_colors <- c("#8dcabd", "#e3b1b8", "#caecbc", "#d1bbdf", "#9db8da", "#e0bf9d", "#8ad6e4", "#e6d2c7", "#b9d7eb", "#aac5a4" ,"#ddaa98", "#a2bebd")
names(CC_colors) <- c("cc1",   "cc12" , "cc17" , "cc19",  "cc22",  "cc23"  ,"cc26"  ,"cc283", "cc327", "cc452", "cc459" ,"No_CC")
Age_cat_colors <- c("#004488", "#DDAA33", "#BB5566")
```


# Plot Fasttree by COUNTRY
## USA CDC
```{r}
# SC tips
Fasttree_CDC_p1 <- ggtree(Fasttree_mid_metadata_CDC, ladderize = T, lwd=0.1) + 
  geom_tippoint(aes(color=as.factor(SC2)),size=1.5)+
  scale_colour_manual(name="SC", values=SC_colors) +
  guides(color = guide_legend(ncol=3))

# Serotype
Fasttree_CDC_p2 <- gheatmap(Fasttree_CDC_p1 + new_scale_fill(), Metadata_Serotype ,  width=0.15, offset=0.0005, 
               font.size = 5, colnames_offset_y = -20, color=NA)+
  scale_fill_manual(values = Serotype_colors, name="1: Serotype")+
  guides(fill = guide_legend(ncol=2))

# CCs
Fasttree_CDC_p3 <- gheatmap(Fasttree_CDC_p2 + new_scale_fill(), Metadata_CC,  width=0.15, offset=0.005,
               font.size = 5, colnames_offset_y = -20, color=NA)+
  scale_fill_manual(values = CC_colors, name="2: CC")+
  guides(fill = guide_legend(ncol=2))

#  Age category
Fasttree_CDC_p4 <- gheatmap(Fasttree_CDC_p3 + new_scale_fill(), Metadata_Age_cat,  width=0.15, offset=0.01,
               font.size = 5, colnames_offset_y = -20, color=NA)+
  scale_fill_manual(values = Age_cat_colors, name="3: Age of Onset")+
  guides(fill = guide_legend(ncol=2))

# WITHOUT LEGEND
Fasttree_CDC_p1_noleg <-  ggtree(Fasttree_mid_metadata_CDC, ladderize = T, lwd=0.1)

# Load SNP distribution across samples
sig_SNPs <- read.delim("~/GitHub/GBS-GWAS-CDC-EOD-LOD/1.Bioinformatics/Ouputs/Pyseer Results/CDC/Sig_SNP.txt")
sig_SNPs_df <- sig_SNPs  |> 
  select(- X.CHROM, -ID, -QUAL, -FILTER, -INFO, -FORMAT)|>
  mutate(across(4:1543, ~ ifelse(grepl("1/1", .), 1, 0)))|>
  mutate(Sum = rowSums(across(4:1543), na.rm = TRUE),
         Proportion = round(Sum / 1540, 3))|>
  mutate(across(4:1543, ~ ifelse(grepl("1", .), "present", "absent")))|>
  mutate(MUT= paste0(REF, POS, ALT), .before = 1)|> 
  select(-POS, -REF, -ALT)

# 1.2. DB-GWAS 
# Load GWAS results
CDC_DBGWAS_data <- read.table("~/GitHub/GBS-GWAS-CDC-EOD-LOD/1.Bioinformatics/Ouputs/Pyseer Results/CDC/Population_Structure_Methods/FastTree_DP_LMM/DBGWAS.txt", sep = "\t", header=T) |> 
  filter(af >=0.05, af <0.95)

# Load Annotations
CDC_DBGWAS_ann <- read.delim("~/GitHub/GBS-GWAS-CDC-EOD-LOD/1.Bioinformatics/Ouputs/Pyseer Results/CDC/Population_Structure_Methods/FastTree_DP_LMM/DBGWAS_annotation.txt", sep = "\t", header=F) 
colnames(CDC_DBGWAS_ann) <- colnames(CDC_DBGWAS_data)
CDC_DBGWAS_ann <- CDC_DBGWAS_ann |> 
  filter(af >=0.05, af <0.95)|>
  mutate(ref_accessory = ifelse(str_extract(notes, "^[^:]+")=="AP018935.1", "ref genome", "unaligned contig"),
         coord_range = str_extract(notes, "(?<=:)[0-9]+-[0-9]+"), 
         start= str_split(coord_range, "-", simplify = T)[,1], 
         end= str_split(coord_range, "-", simplify = T)[,2],
         POS = as.integer(str_extract(coord_range, "^[0-9]+")),
         OR = exp(beta), 
         OR_pos =ifelse(OR<1, "OR<1", "OR>1"))  |>
  separate(
    notes, 
    into = c("contig_position", "upstream", "gene", "downstream"), 
    sep = ";", 
    remove = FALSE, 
    fill = "right"
  )

# Sig hits
CDC_DBGWAS_sig <- CDC_DBGWAS_ann |> 
  filter(lrt.pvalue < 0.05 / 87899) |>
  mutate(ref_accessory = factor(ref_accessory, levels= c("ref genome", "unaligned contig")))|>
  arrange(ref_accessory, as.numeric(start))|>
  mutate(
    OR = exp(beta),
    OR_lower = exp(beta - 1.96 * beta.std.err),
    OR_upper = exp(beta + 1.96 * beta.std.err),
    OR_CI = sprintf("%.2f (%.2f; %.2f)", OR, OR_lower, OR_upper),
    P_value = formatC(lrt.pvalue, format = "e", digits = 2)
  ) |>
  mutate(variant2= paste0("Unitig ",row_number()), 
         annotation= paste0("coord:", coord_range, "(", ref_accessory, "); gene: ", gene))|> 
  select(variant, variant2, af, OR_CI, P_value, annotation) |>
  rename(unitig= variant, 
         variant=variant2)

# Load Unitig distribution across samples
Sig_Unitig <- read.delim("~/GitHub/GBS-GWAS-CDC-EOD-LOD/1.Bioinformatics/Ouputs/Pyseer Results/CDC/Sig_Unitig.txt", sep=" ", header=F)|>
  select(-V2)
Sig_Unitig[] <- lapply(Sig_Unitig, function(x) gsub(":1", "", x)) 
order_unitigs <- CDC_DBGWAS_sig$unitig
Sig_Unitig <- Sig_Unitig |>
  filter(V1 %in% order_unitigs) |>
  mutate(V1 = factor(V1, levels = order_unitigs)) |>
  arrange(V1)|>
  mutate(unitig_number= paste0("Unitig_", 1:nrow(CDC_DBGWAS_sig)))

Unitig_sig_t <- metadata_tree_v0 %>% select(label)
for(i in 1:nrow(Sig_Unitig)){
  present_samples <- as.vector(unlist(Sig_Unitig[i, -1]))
  new_var <- ifelse(Unitig_sig_t$label %in% present_samples, 1, 0)
  Unitig_sig_t[[Sig_Unitig$unitig_number[i]]] <- new_var
}
row.names(Unitig_sig_t) <- Unitig_sig_t$label
Unitig_sig_t <- Unitig_sig_t[,-1]
round(colMeans(Unitig_sig_t %>% select(starts_with("Unitig_"))),3)
Unitig_sig_t[Unitig_sig_t == 0] <- "absent"
Unitig_sig_t[Unitig_sig_t == 1] <- "present" 

# Prepare heatmap data for phylo
unitig_cols <- grep("^Unitig_", colnames(Unitig_sig_t), value = TRUE)
metadata_unitig_list <- lapply(unitig_cols, function(u_col) {
  df <- Unitig_sig_t |> select(all_of(u_col))
  df[[u_col]] <- as.factor(df[[u_col]])      # convert column to factor
  row.names(df) <- row.names(Unitig_sig_t)   # set rownames
  colnames(df) <- u_col                     # ensure column name matches
  df
})
names(metadata_unitig_list) <- unitig_cols

# Arrange legends together

  leg_SNPs, plot_spacer(), leg_Unitigs, plot_spacer(), leg_PanGWAS, 
  ncol = 1, 
  align = "v", 
  axis = "tb", 
  rel_heights = c(1, 0.01, 1, 0.01, 1)
)


legend_combined <- plot_grid(leg_SC, leg_GWAS,  ncol = 2)

final_plot_CDC <- plot_grid(
  Fasttree_CDC_p31 + 
    theme(legend.position = "none",
          plot.margin = margin(t = 5.5, r = 5.5, b = 40, l = 5.5, unit = "pt"))+ 
    coord_cartesian(clip = "off") ,
  legend_combined,
  ncol = 2,
  rel_widths = c(3, 1)
)

# To display or save
print(final_plot_CDC)

# # save
ggsave("~/GitHub/GBS-GWAS-CDC-EOD-LOD/2. Analysis/MS1 - USA GWAS interpretation/CDC_phylo.png", plot = final_plot_CDC, width = 20, height = 10, dpi = 300, units = "in", bg = "white")
```

```{r}
# Load SNP distribution across samples
sig_SNPs_NL <- read.delim("~/GitHub/GBS-GWAS-CDC-EOD-LOD/1.Bioinformatics/Ouputs/Pyseer Results/NDL/Sig_SNP.txt")
sig_SNPs_NL_df <- sig_SNPs_NL  |> 
  select(- CHR, -ID, -QUAL, -FILTER, -INFO, -FORMAT)|>
  mutate(across(4:1340, ~ ifelse(grepl("1/1", .), 1, 0)))|>
  mutate(Sum = rowSums(across(4:1340), na.rm = TRUE),
         Proportion = round(Sum / 1336, 3))|>
  mutate(across(4:1340, ~ ifelse(grepl("1", .), "present", "absent")))|>
  mutate(MUT= paste0(REF, POS, ALT), .before = 1)|> 
  select(-POS, -REF, -ALT)

  arrange(V1)|>

  NL_Unitig_sig_t[[NL_Sig_Unitig$unitig_number[i]]] <- new_var
}
```

# TABLE - Distribution of hits acros serotypes
## CDC
```{r}
sighits_presabs_CDC <- cbind(CDC_SNP_t[CDC_accessions, ], gene_sig_t[CDC_accessions, ], Unitig_sig_t[CDC_accessions, ])
sig_hits_list <- colnames(sighits_presabs_CDC)
sighits_presabs_CDC$label <- row.names(sighits_presabs_CDC)
sighits_presabs_metadata_CDC <- left_join(sighits_presabs_CDC, metadata_tree)|> filter(! is.na(Serotype2))


tab_long_CDC <- sighits_presabs_metadata_CDC |>
  group_by(Serotype2) |>
  summarise(
    Total = paste0("n = ", n()),
    across(all_of(sig_hits_list),
           ~ paste0(round(100 * mean(. == "present")), "%")),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) |>
  pivot_longer(
    cols = c(Total, all_of(sig_hits_list)),
    names_to = "Variable",
    values_to = "Value"
  )

# Now Variables as rows, Serotypes as columns:
tab_wide_CDC <- tab_long_CDC |>
  pivot_wider(
    names_from = Serotype2,
    values_from = Value
  ) |>
  arrange(match(Variable, c("Total", sig_hits_list))) |>
  column_to_rownames("Variable")

# Add a columns for the overall association 
chisquare_fun_CDC <- function(variant){
  chisq.test <- chisq.test(sighits_presabs_metadata_CDC[, variant], sighits_presabs_metadata_CDC[, "Serotype2"])
  pval <- ifelse(chisq.test$p.value<0.01, "<0.01", paste0("=", chisq.test$p.value))
  paste0("X2=", round(chisq.test$statistic, 1), ", p-val", pval  )
}
res <- lapply(sig_hits_list, chisquare_fun_CDC)
res_vec <- unlist(res, use.names = FALSE)

tab_wide_CDC |>
  mutate("Association with cps" = c(NA, res_vec), .before=Ia)

```
```{r}
sighits_presabs_NDL <- cbind(NL_SNP_t[NL_accessions, ], gene_sig_NDL_t[NL_accessions, ], NL_Unitig_sig_t[NL_accessions, ]) |>
  rename(arnC="group_2327", 
         group_1981= "epsJ~~~glyG_2")|>
  mutate(arnC = ifelse(arnC ==1, "present", "absent"), 
         group_1981 = ifelse(group_1981 ==1, "present", "absent"))
sighits_presabs_NDL$label <- row.names(sighits_presabs_NDL)
sighits_presabs_metadata_NDL <- left_join(sighits_presabs_NDL, metadata_tree)|> filter(! is.na(Serotype2))


tab_long_NDL<- sighits_presabs_metadata_NDL|>
  group_by(Serotype2) |>
  summarise(Total = paste0("n = ", n()),
    across(all_of(sig_hits_list),
           ~ paste0(round(100 * mean(. == "present")), "%")),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) |>
  pivot_longer(
    cols = c(Total, all_of(sig_hits_list)),
    names_to = "Variable",
    values_to = "Value"
  )

# Now Variables as rows, Serotypes as columns:
tab_wide_NDL<- tab_long_NDL|>
  pivot_wider(
    names_from = Serotype2,
    values_from = Value
  ) |>
  arrange(match(Variable, c("Total", sig_hits_list))) |>
  column_to_rownames("Variable")

tab_wide_NDL

# Add a columns for the overall association 
chisquare_fun <- function(variant){
  chisq.test <- chisq.test(sighits_presabs_metadata_NDL[, variant], sighits_presabs_metadata_NDL[, "Serotype2"])
  pval <- ifelse(chisq.test$p.value<0.01, "<0.01", paste0("=", chisq.test$p.value))
  paste0("X2=", round(chisq.test$statistic, 1), ", p-val", pval  )
}
res <- lapply(sig_hits_list, chisquare_fun)
res_vec <- unlist(res, use.names = FALSE)

tab_wide_NDL |>
  mutate("Association with cps" = c(NA, res_vec), .before=Ia)
```

# TABLE - Summary of PYSEER results for CDC significant hits among Netherlands samples
```{r}
CDC_sig_hits_among_NDL_samples <- read.table("~/GitHub/GBS-GWAS-CDC-EOD-LOD/1.Bioinformatics/Ouputs/Pyseer Results/NDL/CDC_sig_hits_among_NDL_samples.Rtab")


variant_summary <- sighits_presabs_metadata_NDL |>
  select(sig_hits_list, Age_cat )|>
  pivot_longer(
    cols = all_of(sig_hits_list),
    names_to = "Variant",
    values_to = "Status"
  ) |>
  group_by(Variant) |>
  summarise(
    # denominators
    N_overall  = n(),
    N_EOD      = sum(Age_cat == "EOD"),
    N_LODVLOD  = sum(Age_cat == "LOD/VLOD"),

    # numerators (present)
    n_overall  = sum(Status == "present"),
    n_EOD      = sum(Status == "present" & Age_cat == "EOD"),
    n_LODVLOD  = sum(Status == "present" & Age_cat == "LOD/VLOD"),

    # percentages
    pct_overall = 100 * n_overall / N_overall,
    pct_EOD     = ifelse(N_EOD > 0,     100 * n_EOD     / N_EOD,     NA_real_),
    pct_LODVLOD = ifelse(N_LODVLOD > 0, 100 * n_LODVLOD / N_LODVLOD, NA_real_),

    # nice labels like "12 (34%)"
    overall_label  = paste0(n_overall,  " (", round(pct_overall, 1), "%)"),
    EOD_label      = paste0(n_EOD,      " (", round(pct_EOD,     1), "%)"),
    LODVLOD_label  = paste0(n_LODVLOD,  " (", round(pct_LODVLOD, 1), "%)"),

    .groups = "drop"
  )

left_join(variant_summary |> select(Variant, overall_label, EOD_label,   LODVLOD_label) , 
          CDC_sig_hits_among_NDL_samples |> 
            rename(Variant = hit)  |> 
            select(-af)|> 
            mutate(Variant = str_replace(Variant, "Unitig ", "Unitig_"))|> 
            mutate(Variant = str_replace(Variant, "group", "group_")))|>
  mutate(Variant = factor(Variant, levels= sig_hits_list))|>
           arrange(Variant)|>
  mutate(P_value = signif(P_value, 2))
```
